response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id), r AS (SELECT film_id, copies, share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY copies DESC) AS rnk FROM c) SELECT film_id, copies, share FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, film_id
